entries.description: Show GitHub CLI authentication status without changing credentials. Use when the spoken call is @orchestrator /github:checks. Do not use to push, merge, or delete.
Inspect and configure GitHub Pages for one repository through the GitHub Pages REST API; dry-run by default and remote mutation only with explicit Apply.

Inspect and run GitHub Actions workflows locally through act using the same bounded script for agent and manual terminal execution; actual jobs require explicit apply.

Generate a customer-owned GitHub template bootstrap workflow and local PMCR-O marketplace provisioning script; dry-run by default, no remote mutation, and compatible with optional GitHub App repository dispatch.
